type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: no_go_theorem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (S : SentienceMeasure) (h_axiom_a : axiom_null_micro_sentience S) (h_axiom_c : axiom_refinement_invariance S) (h_axiom_d : axiom_structural_closure S) : ∀ (X : System), X.vertices.card < ω → S X = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: positive_sentience_requires_axiom_rejection
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (S : SentienceMeasure) (X : System) (h_positive : S X > 0) : ¬axiom_null_micro_sentience S ∨ ¬axiom_compositional_additivity S ∨ ¬axiom_refinement_invariance S ∨ ¬axiom_structural_closure S

theorems_only_on_branches.name: single_component_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (S : SentienceMeasure) (h_axiom_a : axiom_null_micro_sentience S) (m : Microcomponent) : S (singleton_system m) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: zero_preservation_disconnected
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (S : SentienceMeasure) (h_axiom_a : axiom_null_micro_sentience S) (h_axiom_b : axiom_compositional_additivity S) : ∀ (X : System), is_disconnected X → S X = 0
